SendEmailValueApproval.description:
Whether an administrator approved a requested VALUE (address or budget).

Hangs on the VALUE, not the project: if approved for one value and the project changes
it, that is a new request. Both address and budget use this shape; both are text so a
single shape fits both.

approved-value.description: The last value an administrator approved, which keeps applying while a new request is open.
approved-value.title: Approved-Value

history.description: Verdict history: one {date, status, by, message} entry per decision.
history.title: History

status.description: requested, approved or denied. Written by the platform's approval flow.
status.title: Status

value.description: The value this verdict is about. Written by the platform's approval flow.
value.title: Value

SendEmailValueApproval.title: SendEmailValueApproval

description:
What ONE deployment may decide about its own outgoing mail (RC-401).

The account is per deployment, so the budget and the sender are too. A field left out
is inherited from the project; a field that is filled in is this deployment's own, and
an address or a budget above the platform default is its own REQUEST. That separation
is deliberate: a deployment with an approved override keeps it when the project lowers
its own value, while a deployment that inherits follows the project down.

from-address.description: Sender address asked to send from, e.g. 'noreply@rijksoverheid.nl'. It only takes effect once a platform administrator has approved that exact value; until then the platform composes the address itself. Leave it out to inherit the project's address. Het afzenderadres moet een adres in rijksoverheid.nl zijn, met voor de @ hoogstens 64 tekens uit kleine letters, cijfers en . _ + - (bijvoorbeeld noreply@rijksoverheid.nl). Een ander domein lijnt niet uit met de envelope en komt niet door DMARC.
from-address.title: From-Address

from-address-approval.description: Whether an administrator has allowed the sender address this deployment requested. Written by the platform: until it says approved for exactly the address in from-address, this deployment sends from the inherited address.

from-name.description: Display name shown to the recipient, e.g. 'Algoritmeregister'. The relay puts this in the From: header next to the sender address, so it may not contain control characters, an @, angle brackets, quotes, a backslash or a dollar sign, and it is at most 64 characters. Leave it out to inherit the project's display name.
from-name.title: From-Name

messages-per-day.description: Messages per day, enforced by the relay per account. Up to and including the platform default this is a free choice; above that it is a REQUEST requiring approval. Leave it out to inherit the project's budget. The 1000000 ceiling only catches typos.
messages-per-day.title: Messages-Per-Day

messages-per-day-approval.description: Whether an administrator approved the budget this deployment requested. Until approved for exactly the requested number, the relay enforces the last approved override or the inherited budget.
